was: Small USFS campground (Uinta-Wasatch-Cache NF, Spanish Fork RD) at the junction of Sheep Creek Rd, Rays Valley Rd and Third Water/Unicorn Ridge Rd between US-6 and Strawberry Reservoir, ~7,600 ft; ~6 RV-capable gravel spurs, vault toilet, no water, 14-day limit. First-come, first-served ($10/3 days). --Claude

was: Established USFS dispersed fee camping area (Uinta-Wasatch-Cache NF, Pleasant Grove RD) near MM17 on the Alpine Loop (UT-92), American Fork Canyon. Drive-in dirt clearings, no water, no hookups; self-pay fee $10/3-day, $20/7-day, $60/season. First-come, first-served (no reservations). Access via narrow winding Alpine Loop; official guidance says not recommended over 30 ft and no trailers, so a 23-ft motorhome is within the limit but the road is tight. --Claude

was: Manti-La Sal NF campground in Upper Joes Valley next to two ponds at ~9,000 ft, reached via the well-maintained dirt/gravel Miller Flat Rd (car/RV accessible). Single, double and equestrian sites; per recreation.gov various sites take RVs up to 25, 30, or 40 ft. Tables and fire rings with grills, vault toilets, no drinking water/electricity/trash. Some sites reservable online, remainder first-come, first-served ($3 per vehicle). Arapeen OHV trail access. --Claude

was: Primitive drive-in campground on the South Fork Shenandoah River. No hookups: picnic table and fire ring per site, portable toilets serviced weekly, generators permitted, self-contained campers and RVs explicitly allowed; grass sites reached by a gravel drive along the riverbank. 17 sites the operator calls riverfront plus others with river access, and a large area for groups of 25+. Rates are $40 flat site fee plus $40 per night per vehicle and $2 credit card fee; 50% deposit at booking. Drive-ups accepted April 1 to October 1 and sites reservable by phone year round. Quiet time from midnight to 8 AM which is late by campground standards, so music can run well into the night. RV Life 5*/$$ ~$35/night (auto 9/2026). --Claude

was: Tonto NF shoreline camping area on the north arm of Theodore Roosevelt Lake, ~7 mi north of Roosevelt Dam off SR-188. Drive-in via a parking-lot access to undesignated shoreline sites (no numbered pads), portable toilets, no potable water. Trailers/RVs under 32 ft. First-come, first-served with a Tonto Discovery/day-use pass ($8 at vendor / $12 on-site). Seasonally closed Nov 15-Feb 15 to protect migratory waterfowl; prone to flash floods and shoreline shrinks at high water. --Claude

was: Tonto NF primitive shoreline camping area on the east side of Bartlett Reservoir; flat sandy terrain, self-select undesignated sites, RVs welcome. No hookups; restrooms/water and day-use ramadas nearby. Access via FR 459 (paved, low-speed) then ~0.5 mi unpaved. Requires a Tonto Daily Pass ($8/vehicle) or Annual Discovery Pass; no reservations. --Claude

was: White Mountain Apache Tribe (Fort Apache Reservation), Hawley Lake ~8,200 ft. About 100 drive-in sites plus a small RV area; potable-water faucets, vault toilets, station/store on site. Tribal recreation permit required (tent camping ~$9, RV ~$25); first-come, first-served. Max RV ~24 ft reported. --Claude

was: ODFW Summer Lake Wildlife Area; 4 primitive first-come campgrounds (River Ranch, Rest Lake, Bullgate Dike, Southwest) with level open RV-suitable sites, fire rings, vault toilets, no potable water or hookups. Free with ODFW parking/day-use permit. --Claude

was: Lower Similkameen Indian Band campground at the pow-wow grounds, 1400 Ashnola Road off Hwy 3 about 10 minutes from Keremeos, in pine parkland by the river below the Ashnola Mountains: about 55 sites on 33 acres, indoor showers and restrooms, cook house and arbour. Corridor sites C$20; cash only. Book by phone or text. Season 1 May-15 Oct 2026. Caveat (2026-10-09): hookups are not confirmed on any source - plan to dry camp. --Claude

was: About 110-site campground beside the family sugar shack and tubing hill at L'Ange-Gardien (Outaouais), 25 min from Ottawa-Gatineau; 3-service 30A sites 30-73 ft, pool and swimming pond. Single nights sold online: July 2027 3-service 30A C$54, 50A C$57.50 (2025 rate page 2-service C$51-55 + tax). --Claude

was: Town of Musgrave Harbour municipal park ~8 km south of town on Rte 330 (Kittiwake Coast), on a saltwater pond beside an ocean beach. 50/30-amp power+water and water-only drive-in sites; comfort station with washrooms, showers and laundromat; dump station; interpretation centre, playground, walking trail. Serviced $30-$40/night ($40 50-amp), seasonal available; open ~mid-Jun to early Sep. Named for Sir Frederick Banting. --Claude
